verdict.rationale: Retell ships Conductor, a built-in AI assistant that takes plain-language requests. It can draft agents, edit prompts and flows, run simulation tests, investigate calls and chats, build analytics dashboards, and inspect knowledge bases, AI QA results and contacts, proposing changes for the user to review before applying them. This is well covered across many first-party doc pages. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Conductor's task delegation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Conductor is Retell's AI assistant for building agents, investigating conversations, and improving analytics dashboards. Ask for what you need in plain language, attach relevant context, and review proposed changes before applying them.
Ask Conductor to change your agent's prompts, settings, or conversation flow in plain language. It proposes edits for you to review before applying them.
Conductor can run simulation tests that play out a scenario against your agent and show how it responds.
click **Generate from prompt** (marked Suggested) to let [Conductor](/conductor/create-agent) draft an agent from a plain-English description of your use case
